street.description: Verlan, banlieue slang, hyper-casual youth — TikTok/Twitch native.

casual_social.description: Default French B2C — informal but elegant, tu-form for under-40 audiences.

professional_casual.description: Paris LinkedIn — vous-form, polished, slightly formal.

corporate_formal.description: Press, government, luxury — strict vous, formal lexicon.

grammar_quirks: Tu vs vous — strict register marker
Negation 'ne' often dropped in casual ('je sais pas' for 'je ne sais pas')
Verlan = syllable-reversed slang, mostly in banlieue and youth contexts

code_switching_patterns.english_in_french: Moderate in tech/marketing/Gen Z; heavy resistance from Académie française.
rules: Older audiences (50+) react negatively to anglicisms

do_not_use: Quebecois markers (tabarnak, char, chum) — wrong region
Verlan in corporate or 50+ audience copy
